details:
- Enable repo_gpgcheck=1 on the [rhel8-els] repo so dnf verifies the
  signature of the repository metadata (repomd.xml.asc)
- Ship the TuxCare signing key from the source tree and pin its fingerprint
  at build time instead of downloading it during the build
- Seed dnf's per-repo metadata keyring in %posttrans so unattended dnf
  runs keep working after the upgrade
